no_container_runtime.reason: Window is a host systemd daemon with no OCI image, Compose deployment, container secret mount or application consumer; inspected systemd/window.service and tracked packaging files.

no_public_web.reason: Window has no web server, public origin, reverse proxy, browser UI, webhook or HTTP upload path; inspected cmd/window and the systemd unit. Its operator UI is Updater TUI.

no_dashboard_metrics.reason: Window publishes no dashboard metrics or remote storage health; its only health contract is the local daemon status checked by Updater.

no_remote_storage.reason: Window has no upload, backup scheduler, remote storage credential or restore pipeline. Its bounded local test results are disposable diagnostics, not durable user data.

no_service_tokens_or_env.reason: Window has no .env schema, application Access Key, SFTP connection, registry secret reference, provider token or machine enrollment. Pairing uses only a public SSH key and existing operator authentication.

updater_release_ownership.reason: These IDs concern Updater's own signed archive, unit sandbox, transaction errors and rollback; Window publishes no Updater package. The Window release gate separately pins and checks an already published compatible Updater release.
